meta.title: FTMO faster portfolio: fixed12-basket historical screen

risk.lot_sizing: Source request=ceil(0.5% sampled equity/unit-risk) to broker step with original min/max; guard floors min(source-request volume,50/unit-risk,volumeMax); reject below broker min.

meta.model: Estimated sampled-equity immutable-signal replay; exploratory retrospective selection, not genuineFTMO execution or calibrated forward odds.
meta.optimization: Fixed12-roster menu only; no parameter search or post-result roster expansion.

criterion.eligibility: In EVERY four predefined cost/handover scenarios require both completed>=101/134 AND Jan2026-plus completed>=54/71.
criterion.no_eligible_result: Report no configuration meets all frozen criteria; do not relax thresholds or add combinations.
criterion.tied_ablation: CORE3 is also Core4 minusRSI; this duplicate is not rerun as a separate candidate.
criterion.excluded_optional_reference: CurrentFTMO16 reference prospectively omitted byroot; full17 unsupported due3WayGold partial/overlapping lifecycles. No performance-based exclusion.
criterion.roster_authority: Root approved exact12basket menu before outcomes; risk,DI,exits,guard,horizon not optimized.

rules.reserve: 1.25*retained filled initial risk +5 per open position; extra negative open-swap reserve unavailable and omitted (held swap already present in sampled floating).
rules.margin: Gross per-symbol entry notional/leverage proxy; existing+proposed margin<=0.8*projected and proposed<=sampled free margin proxy. No hedging discount.
rules.failure: Hard observed sampled equity breach stops phase permanently; no liquidation. Existing positions retain source exits after guard soft-stop. Soft daily/buffer admission rejection is NOT failure.
rules.target: Phase1 balance>=11000;Phase2>=10500;>=4 distinct Prague entry-fill days per phase; no active positions; never native end-of-test liquidation.

phases.primary_handover: Next Prague civil-date midnight after Phase1 pass.
phases.two_business_day_wait: Advance two weekdays after Phase1 local pass date; activate at midnight of that date; rerun subsequent path, not add waiting to prior result.
phases.phase2: Fresh10000 balance and all phase/day/account state, no position carry-over; same overall180-day deadline.
phases.phase2_started: Account activation before exclusive horizon, even with no trades; first fill separate.
phases.qualification: Both trading phases naturally flat-pass within horizon; optional access date=Phase2pass+5weekdays is arithmetic only, excluded from qualification.
phases.statistics: Phase1 median among Phase1passes; Phase2 median among Phase2passes after actual activation; total median among both-phase completions. No overall50% time if fewer than half all starts complete. No independent binomial CI: overlapping cohorts are dependent.
phases.elapsed: Inclusive Prague civil dates plus fractional elapsed24h and distinct entry days separately.

float_model.source: Single-EA native5-minute equity-minus-balance divided by uniquely owned native open volume.
float_model.ownership: Strict source.open_epoch < mark_epoch < source.close_epoch; discard all source opening/closing epoch marks, duplicates and finalization marks; fail on nonzero unowned interior marks or nonfinite fields.
float_model.event_mark: Latest mark at or before replay event belonging to SAME source position only. Initial floating=0 until first eligible mark; no future interpolation or backfill. Mark remains until later owned mark or source exit; stale age and zero-initial durations logged.
float_model.swap: Native owned floating contains accrued source swap. Final swap booked at strategy close then position floating removed; no future final swap used for entry reserve.
float_model.unknowns: No complete tick path, true broker margin, currentSL/request-cooldown execution, counterfactual entries after skipped source trades, or quote-level pre-request geometry.
float_model.staleness: Latest-owned-past-mark carried without time limit, including closed-market weekends; all mark ages and counts over900seconds reported. No future backfill or cross-position mark reuse; zero before first owned mark explicitly flagged.

costs.base: Actual raw entry costs at entry; recorded remaining commission/fee, gross and swap at original strategy close, scaled by replay lots. No future exit fee is split into entry.
costs.stress: Additional per-side execution cost:USTEC1price point,USDJPY0.01JPY,XAUUSD0.10USD, converted at side entry/exit quote; double negative recorded swap at exit, positive swap unchanged. Source exits unchanged; extra swap accrual between snapshots is not reconstructed.
